name: Elven Accuracy
benefit:
If you miss due to concealment when making a ranged attack with a longbow or shortbow (including composite bows), you can reroll your miss chance roll one time to see if you actually hit.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 119
If you miss an attack with a longbow or shortbow due to concealment, you can spend 5 stamina points to automatically succeed at the miss chance reroll from this feat.
flavor: Your sharp eyesight makes difficult shots easier.
